<details>

The declared source is a standard `git+https` URL pointing to a GitHub repository, and `sha256sums = SKIP` is standard Arch practice for VCS packages.

The project URL (`https://getartcraft.com/apps/vectorcraft`) differs from the source repository domain (`github.com/storytold`), which is worth verifying but is not inherently malicious—it may simply reflect the upstream website versus the code host. There are no suspicious network commands, obfuscated strings, `eval`, `curl|bash`, or unexpected file operations present in this file.

Because this file is pure metadata with no build or install logic, it does not constitute evidence of a supply-chain attack. The actual risk would reside in the `PKGBUILD` or the upstream source code, which are outside the scope of this file.
</details>
